import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import parse_port  # noqa: E402


class ParsePortValidTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_boundaries(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("1"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("65535"), 65535)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("65534"), 65534)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("2"), 2)

    def test_common_ports(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("80"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("443"), 443)

    def test_leading_zeros_allowed(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("080"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("00001"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0065535"), 65535)

    def test_surrounding_spaces_allowed(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port(" 8080"), 8080)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("8080 "), 8080)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("  8080  "), 8080)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port(" 0001 "), 1)

    def test_returns_int(self):
        self.assertIs(type(parse_port("22")), int)


class ParsePortInvalidTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def assertRejects(self, value):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            parse_port(value)

    def test_zero_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("0")
        self.assertRejects("00")
        self.assertRejects(" 0 ")

    def test_above_range_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("65536")
        self.assertRejects("99999")
        self.assertRejects("070000")
        self.assertRejects("100000")

    def test_signs_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("+80")
        self.assertRejects("-1")
        self.assertRejects("-0")
        self.assertRejects(" +80 ")

    def test_tabs_and_newlines_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("\t80")
        self.assertRejects("80\t")
        self.assertRejects("\n80")
        self.assertRejects("80\n")
        self.assertRejects("\r\n80")
        self.assertRejects("8\t0")

    def test_other_whitespace_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects(" 80")
        self.assertRejects("80　")
        self.assertRejects("\v80")
        self.assertRejects("\f80")

    def test_non_ascii_digits_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("８０")  # fullwidth "80"
        self.assertRejects("٨٠")  # Arabic-Indic "80"
        self.assertRejects("²")  # superscript two
        self.assertRejects("٢٣")  # Arabic-Indic "23"

    def test_decimal_points_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("80.0")
        self.assertRejects(".80")
        self.assertRejects("80.")
        self.assertRejects("1.5")

    def test_underscores_and_inner_spaces_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("8_0")
        self.assertRejects("1 000")
        self.assertRejects("8 0")

    def test_exponent_and_hex_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("1e3")
        self.assertRejects("0x50")

    def test_empty_and_blank_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("")
        self.assertRejects(" ")
        self.assertRejects("     ")

    def test_non_string_inputs_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects(None)
        self.assertRejects(80)
        self.assertRejects(80.0)
        self.assertRejects(b"80")
        self.assertRejects(bytearray(b"80"))
        self.assertRejects(["80"])
        self.assertRejects(True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import copy
import os
import random
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import topological_order  # noqa: E402


def is_valid_order(order, nodes, edges):
    if sorted(order) != sorted(nodes) or len(order) != len(set(order)):
        return False
    position = {node: i for i, node in enumerate(order)}
    return all(position[a] < position[b] for a, b in edges)


class TopologicalOrderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_graph(self):
        self.assertEqual(topological_order([], []), [])

    def test_isolated_nodes_are_included_once(self):
        nodes = ["x", "y", "z"]
        order = topological_order(nodes, [])
        self.assertTrue(is_valid_order(order, nodes, []))

    def test_chain(self):
        nodes = ["c", "a", "b"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), ["a", "b", "c"])

    def test_diamond(self):
        nodes = ["d", "c", "b", "a"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "c"), ("b", "d"), ("c", "d")]
        order = topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertTrue(is_valid_order(order, nodes, edges))

    def test_mixed_isolated_and_connected(self):
        nodes = ["solo", "b", "a", "other"]
        edges = [("a", "b")]
        order = topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertTrue(is_valid_order(order, nodes, edges))
        self.assertIn("solo", order)
        self.assertIn("other", order)

    def test_duplicate_edges_do_not_create_false_cycle(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("a", "b")]
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), ["a", "b"])

    def test_two_node_cycle_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_longer_cycle_raises(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c", "d"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("c", "d"), ("d", "b")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)

    def test_cycle_with_unrelated_node_raises(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "free"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)

    def test_self_loop_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a"], [("a", "a")])

    def test_self_loop_among_other_nodes_raises(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "b")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)

    def test_duplicate_edges_with_cycle_still_raises(self):
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "a"), ("b", "a")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], edges)

    def test_inputs_not_mutated(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
        nodes_before = copy.deepcopy(nodes)
        edges_before = copy.deepcopy(edges)
        topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(nodes, nodes_before)
        self.assertEqual(edges, edges_before)

    def test_inputs_not_mutated_when_cycle_raises(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")]
        nodes_before = copy.deepcopy(nodes)
        edges_before = copy.deepcopy(edges)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(nodes, nodes_before)
        self.assertEqual(edges, edges_before)

    def test_edges_as_lists_and_generator(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        edges = (pair for pair in [["a", "b"], ["b", "c"]])
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), ["a", "b", "c"])

    def test_random_dags_produce_valid_orders(self):
        rng = random.Random(1234)
        for _ in range(200):
            size = rng.randint(0, 12)
            nodes = [f"n{i}" for i in range(size)]
            shuffled = nodes[:]
            rng.shuffle(shuffled)
            edges = []
            for i in range(size):
                for j in range(i + 1, size):
                    if rng.random() < 0.3:
                        edges.append((shuffled[i], shuffled[j]))
                        if rng.random() < 0.2:
                            edges.append((shuffled[i], shuffled[j]))
            rng.shuffle(edges)
            order = topological_order(nodes, edges)
            self.assertTrue(is_valid_order(order, nodes, edges))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import copy
import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import topological_order  # noqa: E402


def assert_valid_order(test, order, nodes, edges):
    test.assertEqual(sorted(order), sorted(nodes))
    position = {node: i for i, node in enumerate(order)}
    for a, b in edges:
        test.assertLess(position[a], position[b], f"{a} must precede {b}")


class TopologicalOrderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def check(self, nodes, edges):
        order = topological_order(nodes, edges)
        assert_valid_order(self, order, nodes, edges)
        return order

    def test_empty_graph(self):
        self.assertEqual(topological_order([], []), [])

    def test_isolated_nodes_are_all_included(self):
        self.check(["x", "y", "z"], [])
        self.assertEqual(sorted(topological_order(["x", "y", "z"], [])), ["x", "y", "z"])

    def test_chain(self):
        nodes = ["c", "a", "b"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
        self.assertEqual(self.check(nodes, edges), ["a", "b", "c"])

    def test_diamond(self):
        nodes = ["d", "c", "b", "a"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "c"), ("b", "d"), ("c", "d")]
        order = self.check(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(order[0], "a")
        self.assertEqual(order[-1], "d")

    def test_isolated_nodes_mixed_with_edges(self):
        nodes = ["solo", "a", "b", "other"]
        self.check(nodes, [("a", "b")])

    def test_duplicate_edges_do_not_create_false_cycle(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
        self.check(nodes, edges)

    def test_duplicate_edges_still_detect_real_cycle(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "a"), ("b", "a")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)

    def test_self_loop_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a"], [("a", "a")])

    def test_self_loop_among_other_nodes_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b", "c"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "b")])

    def test_two_cycle_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_longer_cycle_raises(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c", "d"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("c", "d"), ("d", "b")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)

    def test_cycle_disconnected_from_acyclic_part_raises(self):
        nodes = ["p", "q", "x", "y"]
        edges = [("p", "q"), ("x", "y"), ("y", "x")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)

    def test_inputs_not_mutated(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c", "d"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("a", "d")]
        nodes_before = copy.deepcopy(nodes)
        edges_before = copy.deepcopy(edges)
        topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(nodes, nodes_before)
        self.assertEqual(edges, edges_before)

    def test_inputs_not_mutated_on_cycle(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(nodes, ["a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(edges, [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_large_chain(self):
        n = 100_000
        nodes = [str(i) for i in range(n)]
        edges = [(nodes[i], nodes[i + 1]) for i in range(n - 1)]
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), nodes)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

    for a, b in edges:

        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), ["a", "b", "c"])

    def test_diamond(self):
        nodes = ["d", "c", "b", "a"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "c"), ("b", "d"), ("c", "d")]
        assert_valid_order(self, topological_order(nodes, edges), nodes, edges)

    def test_isolated_nodes_mixed_with_edges(self):
        nodes = ["lone", "a", "b", "other"]
        edges = [("b", "a")]

        assert_valid_order(self, order, nodes, edges)

        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b", "c"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("c", "a")])

    def test_self_loop_raises(self):

import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "src"))

from solution import search  # noqa: E402

ROWS = [
    (1, "alice"),
    (2, "alice"),
    (3, "al%ice"),
    (4, "al_ce"),
    (5, "alpha"),
    (6, "a\\b"),
    (7, "a"),
    (8, "ab"),
    (9, "%done"),
    (10, "_x"),
    (11, "x_y"),
    (12, "xzy"),
    (13, "100%"),
]


def make_conn(rows):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
    conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)", rows)
    return conn


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.conn = make_conn(ROWS)

    def tearDown(self):
        self.conn.close()

    def test_prefix_matches_and_orders_by_name_then_id(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            search(self.conn, "al", 10),
            [(3, "al%ice"), (4, "al_ce"), (1, "alice"), (2, "alice"), (5, "alpha")],
        )

    def test_percent_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "al%", 10), [(3, "al%ice")])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "%", 10), [(9, "%done")])

    def test_underscore_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "al_", 10), [(4, "al_ce")])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "_", 10), [(10, "_x")])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "x_", 10), [(11, "x_y")])

    def test_backslash_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "a\\", 10), [(6, "a\\b")])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "\\", 10), [])

    def test_limit_is_clamped_to_at_least_one(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "a", 0), [(7, "a")])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "a", -5), [(7, "a")])

    def test_limit_is_applied(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "a", 2), [(7, "a"), (6, "a\\b")])

    def test_limit_is_clamped_to_at_most_100(self):
        conn = make_conn([(i, "n%03d" % i) for i in range(150)])
        try:
            rows = search(conn, "n", 1000)
        finally:
            conn.close()
        self.assertEqual(len(rows), 100)
        self.assertEqual(rows[0], (0, "n000"))

    def test_bool_limit_is_rejected(self):
        for value in (True, False):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(self.conn, "a", value)

    def test_non_int_limit_is_rejected(self):
        for value in ("5", 5.0, None, [5]):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(self.conn, "a", value)

    def test_non_str_prefix_is_rejected(self):
        for value in (None, 5, b"a"):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    search(self.conn, value, 10)

    def test_sql_metacharacters_in_prefix_are_not_executed(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "x' OR '1'='1", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "' OR 1=1 --", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "a", 10)[0], (7, "a"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import search  # noqa: E402


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        self.conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
        names = [
            "alice",
            "alan",
            "100%_done",
            "100x_done",
            "a_b",
            "axb",
            "back\\slash",
            "backslash",
            "bob",
            "ann",
        ]
        self.conn.executemany(
            "INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)",
            [(i, n) for i, n in enumerate(names, start=1)],
        )

    def tearDown(self):
        self.conn.close()

    def names(self, rows):
        return [name for _, name in rows]

    def test_basic_prefix(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.names(search(self.conn, "al", 10)), ["alan", "alice"])

    def test_percent_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.names(search(self.conn, "100%", 10)), ["100%_done"])

    def test_percent_does_not_match_everything(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "%", 10), [])

    def test_underscore_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.names(search(self.conn, "a_", 10)), ["a_b"])

    def test_underscore_does_not_match_any_char(self):
        self.assertNotIn("axb", self.names(search(self.conn, "a_", 10)))

    def test_backslash_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.names(search(self.conn, "back\\", 10)), ["back\\slash"])

    def test_empty_prefix_matches_all(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", 100)), 10)

    def test_injection_attempt_is_inert(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "' OR '1'='1", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "x'; DROP TABLE users; --", 10), [])
        count = self.conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").fetchone()[0]
        self.assertEqual(count, 10)

    def test_ordering_by_name_then_id(self):
        self.conn.execute("INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (0, 'alice')")
        rows = search(self.conn, "alice", 10)
        self.assertEqual(rows, [(0, "alice"), (2, "alice")][:0] + rows)
        self.assertEqual(rows, sorted(rows, key=lambda r: (r[1], r[0])))
        self.assertEqual(rows[0], (0, "alice"))

    def test_limit_applied(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", 3)), 3)

    def test_limit_clamped_low(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", 0)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", -5)), 1)

    def test_limit_clamped_high(self):
        self.conn.executemany(
            "INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)",
            [(1000 + i, "bulk%03d" % i) for i in range(150)],
        )
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "bulk", 500)), 100)

    def test_bool_limit_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(self.conn, "", True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(self.conn, "", False)

    def test_non_int_limit_rejected(self):
        for bad in ("5", 5.0, None, [5]):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                search(self.conn, "", bad)

    def test_non_str_prefix_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            search(self.conn, None, 5)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            search(self.conn, b"al", 5)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import search  # noqa: E402


def make_db(names):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
    conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)", list(enumerate(names, 1)))
    return conn


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_percent_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["100% off", "100x off", "1000 off", "100%"])
        rows = search(conn, "100%", 10)
        self.assertEqual([name for _, name in rows], ["100%", "100% off"])

    def test_underscore_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["a_c", "abc", "a_", "ab"])
        rows = search(conn, "a_", 10)
        self.assertEqual([name for _, name in rows], ["a_", "a_c"])

    def test_backslash_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["a\\b", "ab", "a\\"])
        rows = search(conn, "a\\", 10)
        self.assertEqual([name for _, name in rows], ["a\\", "a\\b"])

    def test_backslash_before_percent_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["x\\%y", "x\\zz", "xq%y"])
        rows = search(conn, "x\\%", 10)
        self.assertEqual([name for _, name in rows], ["x\\%y"])

    def test_sql_injection_attempt_is_treated_as_text(self):
        conn = make_db(["alice", "bob"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "' OR '1'='1", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "x'; DROP TABLE users; --", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "", 10)), 2)

    def test_orders_by_name_then_id(self):

import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import search  # noqa: E402


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        self.conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
        names = [
            (1, "alice"),
            (2, "alfred"),
            (3, "al%ice"),
            (4, "al_ice"),
            (5, "al\\ice"),
            (6, "bob"),
            (7, "alice"),
            (8, None),
        ]
        self.conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users VALUES (?, ?)", names)

    def tearDown(self):
        self.conn.close()

    def test_prefix_match_sorted_by_name_then_id(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            search(self.conn, "al", 10),
            [(5, "al\\ice"), (4, "al_ice"), (3, "al%ice"), (2, "alfred"), (1, "alice"), (7, "alice")][::1][:0]
            + [(3, "al%ice"), (4, "al_ice"), (5, "al\\ice"), (2, "alfred"), (1, "alice"), (7, "alice")],
        )

    def test_percent_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "%", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "al%", 10), [(3, "al%ice")])

    def test_underscore_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "al_", 10), [(4, "al_ice")])

    def test_backslash_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "al\\", 10), [(5, "al\\ice")])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "\\", 10), [])

    def test_empty_prefix_matches_all_non_null_names(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", 100)), 7)

    def test_limit_is_applied(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "al", 2), [(3, "al%ice"), (4, "al_ice")])

    def test_limit_clamped_low(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", 0)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", -50)), 1)

    def test_limit_clamped_high(self):
        self.conn.executemany(
            "INSERT INTO users VALUES (?, ?)",
            [(100 + i, "zz%02d" % i) for i in range(150)],
        )
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "zz", 1000)), 100)

    def test_rejects_bool_limit(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(self.conn, "al", True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(self.conn, "al", False)

    def test_rejects_non_integer_limit(self):
        for bad in ("10", 1.5, None, [10]):
            with self.subTest(limit=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(self.conn, "al", bad)

    def test_rejects_non_string_prefix(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            search(self.conn, None, 10)

    def test_injection_attempt_is_inert(self):
        payload = "x' OR '1'='1"
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, payload, 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(len(self.conn.execute("SELECT * FROM users").fetchall()), 8)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src"))

from solution import read_people  # noqa: E402


class ReadPeopleTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_parses_rows_in_order(self):
        text = "name,age\nAnn,30\nBob,4\n"
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people(text),
            [{"name": "Ann", "age": 30}, {"name": "Bob", "age": 4}],
        )

    def test_header_only_returns_empty_list(self):
        self.assertEqual(read_people("name,age\n"), [])
        self.assertEqual(read_people("name,age"), [])

    def test_quoted_name_with_comma(self):
        text = 'name,age\n"Lee, Ann",41\n'
        self.assertEqual(read_people(text), [{"name": "Lee, Ann", "age": 41}])

    def test_quoted_name_with_doubled_quote(self):
        text = 'name,age\n"say ""hi""",7\n'
        self.assertEqual(read_people(text), [{"name": 'say "hi"', "age": 7}])

    def test_quoted_name_with_embedded_lf(self):
        text = 'name,age\n"Ann\nLee",30\nBob,4\n'
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people(text),
            [{"name": "Ann\nLee", "age": 30}, {"name": "Bob", "age": 4}],
        )

    def test_quoted_name_with_embedded_crlf(self):
        text = 'name,age\r\n"Ann\r\nLee",30\r\n'
        self.assertEqual(read_people(text), [{"name": "Ann\r\nLee", "age": 30}])

    def test_crlf_line_endings(self):
        text = "name,age\r\nAnn,30\r\nBob,4\r\n"
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people(text),
            [{"name": "Ann", "age": 30}, {"name": "Bob", "age": 4}],
        )

    def test_age_bounds_are_inclusive(self):
        text = "name,age\nA,0\nB,130\n"
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people(text),
            [{"name": "A", "age": 0}, {"name": "B", "age": 130}],
        )

    def test_quoted_age_is_accepted(self):
        self.assertEqual(read_people('name,age\nAnn,"30"\n'), [{"name": "Ann", "age": 30}])

    def test_wrong_header_raises(self):
        bad_headers = [
            "",
            "age,name\nAnn,30\n",
            "Name,Age\nAnn,30\n",
            "name,age,city\nAnn,30,X\n",
            "name\nAnn\n",
            "name ,age\nAnn,30\n",
            "# comment\nname,age\nAnn,30\n",
        ]
        for text in bad_headers:
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    read_people(text)

    def test_missing_column_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people("name,age\nAnn\n")

    def test_extra_column_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people("name,age\nAnn,30,extra\n")

    def test_empty_line_in_data_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people("name,age\nAnn,30\n\nBob,4\n")

    def test_unterminated_quote_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people('name,age\n"Ann,30\n')

    def test_text_after_closing_quote_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people('name,age\n"Ann"x,30\n')

    def test_quoted_name_with_comma_missing_quote_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people('name,age\n"Lee, Ann,41\n')

    def test_invalid_ages_raise(self):
        bad_ages = [
            "",
            " 30",
            "30 ",
            "-1",
            "+5",
            "3.5",
            "1e2",
            "abc",
            "3_0",
            "0x1E",
            "131",
            "1000",
            "٣٠",  # Arabic-Indic digits
            "²",  # superscript two
        ]
        for age in bad_ages:
            with self.subTest(age=age):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    read_people(f"name,age\nAnn,{age}\n")

    def test_error_in_later_row_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people("name,age\nAnn,30\nBob,200\n")

    def test_empty_input_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people("")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from solution import utc_day_start


class UtcDayStartTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def assertDay(self, text, year, month, day):
        self.assertEqual(
            utc_day_start(text),
            datetime(year, month, day, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
            msg=text,
        )

    def test_z_suffix_keeps_same_day(self):
        self.assertDay("2025-01-01T00:00:00Z", 2025, 1, 1)
        self.assertDay("2025-01-01T23:59:59.999999Z", 2025, 1, 1)

    def test_result_is_utc_midnight(self):
        result = utc_day_start("2025-06-15T13:45:10Z")
        self.assertEqual(result, datetime(2025, 6, 15, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
        self.assertIs(result.tzinfo, timezone.utc)
        self.assertEqual(result.utcoffset().total_seconds(), 0)

    def test_positive_offset_moves_to_previous_utc_day(self):
        self.assertDay("2025-01-01T00:30:00+02:00", 2024, 12, 31)

    def test_negative_offset_moves_to_next_utc_day(self):
        self.assertDay("2025-01-01T23:30:00-02:00", 2025, 1, 2)

    def test_offset_exactly_on_utc_midnight_stays_on_that_day(self):
        self.assertDay("2025-01-01T02:00:00+02:00", 2025, 1, 1)
        self.assertDay("2025-01-01T00:00:00+00:00", 2025, 1, 1)

    def test_offset_with_minutes_crosses_day_boundary(self):
        self.assertDay("2025-01-01T05:30:00+05:30", 2025, 1, 1)
        self.assertDay("2025-01-01T05:29:00+05:30", 2024, 12, 31)

    def test_extreme_offsets(self):
        self.assertDay("2025-01-01T23:59:00+14:00", 2025, 1, 1)
        self.assertDay("2025-01-01T00:00:00-12:00", 2025, 1, 1)
        self.assertDay("2025-01-01T11:00:00-12:00", 2025, 1, 1)
        self.assertDay("2025-01-01T11:00:00+14:00", 2024, 12, 31)

    def test_leap_day_is_preserved(self):
        self.assertDay("2024-02-29T12:00:00Z", 2024, 2, 29)
        self.assertDay("2024-03-01T00:30:00+01:00", 2024, 2, 29)
        self.assertDay("2024-02-29T00:30:00+01:00", 2024, 2, 28)

    def test_invalid_leap_day_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            utc_day_start("2023-02-29T00:00:00Z")

    def test_naive_timestamp_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            utc_day_start("2025-01-01T00:30:00")

    def test_date_only_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            utc_day_start("2025-01-01")

    def test_invalid_input_is_rejected(self):
        for bad in [
            "",
            "not a timestamp",
            "2025-13-01T00:00:00Z",
            "2025-01-01T00:00:00+25:00",
            "0001-01-01T00:00:00+01:00",
            "Z",
            None,
            20250101,
        ]:
            with self.subTest(text=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    utc_day_start(bad)

    def test_machine_timezone_is_ignored(self):
        if not hasattr(time, "tzset"):
            self.skipTest("time.tzset not available on this platform")
        original = os.environ.get("TZ")
        try:
            os.environ["TZ"] = "XYZ-14"
            time.tzset()
            self.assertDay("2025-01-01T00:30:00+02:00", 2024, 12, 31)
        finally:
            if original is None:
                del os.environ["TZ"]
            else:
                os.environ["TZ"] = original
            time.tzset()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from solution import resolve_upload


class ResolveUploadTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(tmp.cleanup)
        base = Path(tmp.name).resolve()
        self.root = base / "root"
        self.root.mkdir()
        self.sibling = base / "sibling"
        self.sibling.mkdir()
        self.secret = self.sibling / "secret.txt"
        self.secret.write_text("secret")
        self.prefix_sibling = base / "root-other"
        self.prefix_sibling.mkdir()

    def test_simple_name(self):
        self.assertEqual(resolve_upload(self.root, "a.txt"), self.root / "a.txt")

    def test_nested_nonexistent_path(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            resolve_upload(self.root, "a/b/c.txt"), self.root / "a" / "b" / "c.txt"
        )

    def test_does_not_create_anything(self):
        resolve_upload(self.root, "new/dir/file.txt")
        self.assertEqual(list(self.root.iterdir()), [])

    def test_absolute_path_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, str(self.secret))

    def test_root_itself_rejected(self):
        for supplied in ("", ".", "a/.."):
            with self.subTest(supplied=supplied):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    resolve_upload(self.root, supplied)

    def test_traversal_to_sibling_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "../sibling/secret.txt")

    def test_traversal_to_prefix_sibling_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "../root-other/file.txt")

    def test_symlinked_directory_to_sibling_rejected(self):
        os.symlink(self.sibling, self.root / "link")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "link/secret.txt")

    def test_symlinked_file_to_sibling_rejected(self):
        os.symlink(self.secret, self.root / "filelink")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "filelink")

    def test_dangling_symlink_to_outside_rejected(self):
        os.symlink(self.sibling / "not-yet.txt", self.root / "dangling")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "dangling")

    def test_symlink_inside_root_allowed(self):
        (self.root / "inner").mkdir()
        os.symlink(self.root / "inner", self.root / "alias")
        self.assertEqual(
            resolve_upload(self.root, "alias/f.txt"), self.root / "inner" / "f.txt"
        )

    def test_symlinked_root_is_resolved(self):
        alias_root = self.root.parent / "root-alias"
        os.symlink(self.root, alias_root)
        self.assertEqual(resolve_upload(alias_root, "f.txt"), self.root / "f.txt")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

        (self.root / "existing.txt").write_text("ok")

        self._tmp.cleanup()

        self.assertEqual(resolve_upload(self.root, "a.txt"), self.root / "a.txt")

        self.assertEqual(
            resolve_upload(self.root, "existing.txt"), self.root / "existing.txt"
        )

        result = resolve_upload(self.root, "a/b/new.txt")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "a" / "b" / "new.txt")
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "a").exists())

    def test_accepts_symlink_that_stays_inside_root(self):
        (self.root / "dir").mkdir()
        os.symlink(self.root / "dir", self.root / "inner")
        self.assertEqual(
            resolve_upload(self.root, "inner/file.txt"),
            self.root / "dir" / "file.txt",
        )

    def test_rejects_absolute_path(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, str(self.sibling / "secret.txt"))

    def test_rejects_absolute_path_to_root_itself(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, str(self.root))

    def test_rejects_empty_string_as_root(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "")

    def test_rejects_dot_as_root(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, ".")

    def test_rejects_path_that_normalizes_to_root(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "sub/..")

    def test_rejects_parent_traversal_into_sibling(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "../sibling/secret.txt")

    def test_rejects_traversal_hidden_after_nested_directory(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "a/b/../../../sibling/new.txt")

    def test_rejects_existing_symlink_to_sibling_file(self):
        os.symlink(self.sibling / "secret.txt", self.root / "link.txt")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "link.txt")

    def test_rejects_symlinked_directory_pointing_to_sibling(self):
        os.symlink(self.sibling, self.root / "escape")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "escape/new.txt")

    def test_rejects_dangling_symlink_pointing_outside_root(self):
        os.symlink(self.sibling / "missing.txt", self.root / "dangling")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "dangling")

    def test_rejects_symlink_pointing_to_root(self):
        os.symlink(self.root, self.root / "self")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "self")

    def test_rejects_symlink_loop(self):
        os.symlink(self.root / "loop_b", self.root / "loop_a")
        os.symlink(self.root / "loop_a", self.root / "loop_b")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "loop_a/x")

        self.addCleanup(self._tmp.cleanup)
        base = Path(self._tmp.name).resolve()
        self.root = base / "root"
        self.root.mkdir()
        self.sibling = base / "root2"
        self.sibling.mkdir()
        (self.sibling / "secret.txt").write_text("outside")
        (self.root / "inside.txt").write_text("inside")

    def assertRejected(self, supplied):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, supplied)

    def test_nested_nonexistent_path_is_allowed_and_not_created(self):
        result = resolve_upload(self.root, "a/b/new.txt")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "a" / "b" / "new.txt")
        self.assertTrue(result.is_relative_to(self.root))
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "a").exists())

    def test_existing_file_inside_root_is_allowed(self):
        self.assertEqual(resolve_upload(self.root, "inside.txt"), self.root / "inside.txt")

    def test_dot_segments_that_stay_inside_root_are_allowed(self):
        self.assertEqual(resolve_upload(self.root, "a/../b.txt"), self.root / "b.txt")

    def test_absolute_path_is_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected(str(self.sibling / "secret.txt"))
        self.assertRejected("/etc/passwd")

    def test_root_itself_is_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected("")
        self.assertRejected(".")
        self.assertRejected("a/..")

    def test_traversal_out_of_root_is_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected("../secret.txt")
        self.assertRejected("a/../../root2/secret.txt")

    def test_sibling_with_shared_name_prefix_is_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected("../root2/secret.txt")

    def test_null_byte_is_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected("a\0b")

    def test_symlink_to_outside_file_is_rejected(self):
        self._symlink(self.sibling / "secret.txt", self.root / "link.txt")
        self.assertRejected("link.txt")

    def test_symlink_to_outside_directory_is_rejected(self):
        self._symlink(self.sibling, self.root / "linkdir")
        self.assertRejected("linkdir/secret.txt")
        self.assertRejected("linkdir/new.txt")

    def test_dangling_symlink_to_outside_is_rejected(self):
        self._symlink(self.sibling / "missing.txt", self.root / "dangling")
        self.assertRejected("dangling")

    def test_symlink_loop_is_rejected(self):
        self._symlink(self.root / "loop_b", self.root / "loop_a")
        self._symlink(self.root / "loop_a", self.root / "loop_b")
        self.assertRejected("loop_a")

    def test_symlink_inside_root_is_resolved_and_allowed(self):
        self._symlink(self.root / "inside.txt", self.root / "alias.txt")
        self.assertEqual(resolve_upload(self.root, "alias.txt"), (self.root / "inside.txt").resolve())

    def _symlink(self, target, link):
        try:
            os.symlink(target, link)
        except (OSError, NotImplementedError) as exc:
            self.skipTest(f"symlinks unavailable: {exc}")

import os
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "src"))

from solution import resolve_upload


class ResolveUploadTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        tmp_dir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(tmp_dir.cleanup)
        tmp = Path(tmp_dir.name).resolve()
        self.root = tmp / "root"
        self.sibling = tmp / "root_sibling"
        self.root.mkdir()
        self.sibling.mkdir()
        (self.root / "sub").mkdir()
        (self.sibling / "secret.txt").write_text("secret")

    def test_nested_nonexistent_path_inside_root(self):
        result = resolve_upload(self.root, "a/b/new.txt")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "a" / "b" / "new.txt")

    def test_existing_file_inside_root(self):
        (self.root / "sub" / "file.txt").write_text("data")
        result = resolve_upload(self.root, "sub/file.txt")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "sub" / "file.txt")

    def test_does_not_create_files_or_directories(self):
        before = sorted(self.root.iterdir())
        resolve_upload(self.root, "missing/deep/file.txt")
        self.assertEqual(sorted(self.root.iterdir()), before)
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "missing").exists())

    def test_absolute_path_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, str(self.root / "file.txt"))

    def test_root_itself_rejected(self):
        for supplied in ("", ".", "sub/.."):
            with self.subTest(supplied=supplied):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    resolve_upload(self.root, supplied)

    def test_parent_traversal_rejected(self):
        for supplied in ("..", "../x", "sub/../../x"):
            with self.subTest(supplied=supplied):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    resolve_upload(self.root, supplied)

    def test_sibling_directory_rejected(self):
        for supplied in ("../root_sibling/new.txt", "../root_sibling/secret.txt"):
            with self.subTest(supplied=supplied):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    resolve_upload(self.root, supplied)

    def test_symlink_to_sibling_directory_rejected(self):
        os.symlink(self.sibling, self.root / "escape")
        for supplied in ("escape", "escape/secret.txt", "escape/new.txt"):
            with self.subTest(supplied=supplied):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    resolve_upload(self.root, supplied)

    def test_dangling_symlink_to_outside_rejected(self):
        os.symlink(self.sibling / "new.txt", self.root / "dangling")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "dangling")

    def test_symlink_inside_root_allowed(self):
        os.symlink(self.root / "sub", self.root / "alias")
        result = resolve_upload(self.root, "alias/file.txt")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "sub" / "file.txt")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
